messages:
Priya: Hey team — coordinating a quick docs PR sweep for the quickstart refresh. Active PRs: #482 (hello app rewrite), #489 (SDK v3/auth snippets), #491 (Docker + CI fix). We also have a broken internal link in the quickstart that points to /docs/sdk/v2. Can folks volunteer to review? cc @Matt @Elaine @Sam
Matt: I can take #489 today. Quick Q — for the JS/py examples are we promoting the new sdk helper usage or keeping the explicit header examples?
Priya: Promote the sdk helper to keep examples minimal. For Node we want something like: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });` — but we should standardize the env var name across examples.
Jordan: FYI I pushed a tiny cleanup to #482 to reduce scaffold noise and switched the hello app to streaming responses. Left a note in the PR about the streaming handler.
Elaine: I'll pick up #491 (Docker). Noticed the Dockerfile in that PR was missing the env defaults and had a bad COPY order. Proposed Dockerfile change below — will push as a PR comment:
```
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=""
ENV PORT=8080
EXPOSE $PORT
CMD ["gunicorn", "app:app", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8080"]
```
Sam: ran the site link-checker — it flagged /docs/sdk/v2 as 404. I'll open a tiny PR to replace v2 -> v3 and add a redirect note.
Priya: Thanks. Also we need a short migration blurb in the quickstart about SDK changes (method names + auth). Elaine can you add a 2-paragraph migration subsection and include the minimal python snippet?
Elaine: :thumbsup: will add the migration note and the snippet. Proposed python auth example for the quickstart:
```
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello world")
print(resp.text)
```
Matt: After I review #489 I'll merge it. I'll also check for any API surface wording that needs to mention token scoping. Planning to merge #491 once Elaine's Docker patch is in.
Jordan: I can run a quick smoke test on staging once those merges are done — ping me after merge.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy for docs-service scheduled at 2026-03-22T15:00Z
Priya: Plan summary: reviewers assigned — Matt (auth + SDK phrasing), Elaine (Docker + migration note), Sam (links + final pass). Jordan will smoke test staging. ETA EOD today for reviews. If anyone sees a place where examples still reference old env names (REDWOOD_KEY etc.), flag it here. Thanks!
Sam: Quick follow-up — I'll also sweep the README snippets for the hello app to ensure they use the stream/async handler. :rocket:
